summary: PlacementRequestPreceptors manages assignment, editing, distribution, and validation of preceptors (supervisors) and joint preceptors for placement requests, tracking hours, assessment status, and ensuring business rules around assignment, editing, and deletion are enforced, with UI components and workflow integration.
purpose: To allow management of preceptor(s) for a placement request, including assigning staff, adjusting hours, handling assessments, and ensuring business and validation rules are followed for assignment, editing, deletion, and distribution of supervision responsibilities.

workflows.name: Assign Preceptor
steps: User selects a preceptor from dropdown (populated with applicable staff)
If 'Add New' is selected, launches add staff screen
User enters start and end dates, hours
Optionally assigns a joint preceptor and sets overwrite flag
Form validations enforced (required fields, date formats, hours > 0)
On save, system adds new PlacementRequestStaff entry and updates UI

workflows.name: Edit Preceptor Assignment
steps: User selects edit for a preceptor row
System loads details to form
User can update hours, dates, joint assignment, assessment status
If assessment is submitted, joint preceptor cannot be edited/removed
Form validations enforced
On save, system updates PlacementRequestStaff entry and updates UI

workflows.name: Delete Preceptor Assignment
steps: User clicks delete icon for a preceptor row
If only one preceptor, delete disabled
If more than one, confirmation dialog shown
If assessment answers exist, alert confirms deletion (unassign supervisor and delete assessments)
If no assessment answers, normal delete confirmation
System deletes PlacementRequestStaff entry and updates UI

workflows.name: Distribute Placement Hours Equally
steps: User clicks 'Distribute Equally'
System distributes total placement hours among assigned staff
UI updated to reflect new hour allocations

workflows.name: Joint Preceptor Overwrite Assessment
steps: User assigns joint preceptor and toggles overwrite checkbox
If joint preceptor already has assessment answers, confirmation dialog prompts for overwrite
If accepted, system updates assessment answers

workflows.name: Refresh and Close
steps: User clicks refresh or close
System checks for hour balance (unbalanced prompt if mismatch)
If balanced, closes popup

business_rules: At least one preceptor must be assigned; delete disabled if only one.
Hours assigned must be greater than 0 and numeric.
Start and end dates required and validated.
Assessment status influences edit and delete availability.
If an assessment is submitted, supervisor cannot be unassigned.
If assessment answers exist, unassigning triggers warning and requires confirmation.
Total hours must be balanced against assigned hours, with alerts for over/under.
Joint preceptor and overwrite only enabled if Department uses assessment module.
Preceptor dropdown includes an Add New entry for adding new staff.
validations: Required fields: preceptor, start date, end date, hours.
Date format validation on start/end date.
Hours: must be numeric and greater than 0.
Preceptor compare validator: value must not be 0 (required).
Assessment answer existence checked before allowing deletion or overwrite.
calculations: Total hours vs assigned hours: over/under calculation and prompt.
Distribute equally divides total hours among assigned preceptors.
Hours difference displayed with over/under message.
conditions: ReadOnly mode disables editing, distributing, and saving.
DepartmentUseAssessmentModule toggles visibility/enabling of joint preceptor fields.
Assessment status (Submitted) disables joint preceptor editing.
If only one preceptor, delete action disabled.
If hours are not balanced, closing popup blocked.
system_behavior: UI updates dynamically on add/edit/delete/distribute actions.
Client-side JavaScript handles confirmation dialogs and validations.
Hidden fields track supervisor ID, assessment answer existence, submission status.
Page populates dropdowns based on staff applicability and department settings.
On async postbacks, JavaScript variables and validation logic are re-registered.
dependencies: PlacementRequestStaffController for data operations (add, update, delete, distribute)
UserSession for context, permissions, and agency filtering
Resources for captions, labels, and alert messages
AjaxControlToolkit for modal popup and calendar extenders
exceptions: Assessment submitted: supervisor cannot be removed.
Assessment answers exist: deletion prompts confirmation to delete assessment answers.
If total hours not balanced: alert blocks closing screen.
